reasons.text: The purchase date of 2016-06-23 is before the program's sale window, which starts 2017-01-01, so the unit is not eligible.
The label photo is legible and shows the recalled model B0726Y, and the date code 8/21 is in range, so the product itself is confirmed as recalled. The denial rests on the purchase date alone.
No duplicate claims share a photo, address, email, serial number, or payout account.
The destruction photo does not clearly show the helmet with its straps cut off, so it would also fail the destruction requirement if the claim were otherwise eligible.
